title: Give slugify a test suite and a test script
text:
This repository has no tests at all. Add test/slug.test.js using the
node:test runner, covering slugify() from src/slug.js: ordinary words,
punctuation, leading and trailing separators, and a non-string input.

Also add a "test" script to package.json that runs "node --test".
Do not change src/slug.js: the current behaviour is the contract.
